summary: Workflows archived to Google Cloud Storage appear twice in the UI archive listing. A bug in visibility_archiver.go line 217 was identified and fixed via PR #9329.
userImpact: Users see duplicate entries in the archive list, causing confusion and making it harder to track archived workflows.
rootCause: Bug in visibility_archiver.go line 217 causing duplicate records to be returned for gcloud-archived workflows.
proposedFix: PR #9329 with a fix to the visibility_archiver.go bug
resolutionDetails: PR #9329 was submitted with the proposed fix and was merged
keyQuote: This is a bug in the visibility_archiver.go file on line 217
